title: Diwali
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office hosts a Diwali celebration introduced by Kelly, which leads to humorous and cultural exchanges among the characters, including Michael attempting to propose to Carol. The episode explores themes of cultural diversity, misunderstandings, and relationships, with Michael explaining Diwali as a festival of lights and making jokes about Indian culture.
